feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: After failed execution, health workers say Tennessee's method flouts medical ethics
entry.summary: After a botched lethal injection in May, dozens of Tennessee medical professionals told the governor that healthcare professionals shouldn't help with executions, no matter the method.

entry.title: Netanyahu says a flydubai pilot tried to crash a plane of mostly Israeli passengers
entry.summary: "As the plane was approaching Israel, one of the pilots stabbed the other pilot and tried to crash the plane with everyone on board," but a passenger and crew member broke into the cockpit to stop it.

entry.title: FBI hunting the hackers who stole its employees' sensitive data
entry.summary: The FBI says it's addressing a massive data breach, vowing to go after the hackers it believes are responsible.

entry.title: A startup wants to build a massive nuclear-powered data center on public land in Utah
entry.summary: Valar Atomics wants to place over 450 reactors on more than 9,500 acres in Utah to power a huge data center project.

entry.title: The moment you've been waiting for: America's best student podcasts
entry.summary: We've listened to nearly 1,500 podcasts from all around the U.S. and narrowed them down to 10 middle school and 10 high school finalists.

entry.title: What's behind HHS claims that gender-affirming care 'may' radicalize
entry.summary: The report is the agency's latest effort to chip away at trust in established health care models for transgender people. Critics say it frames transgender identity as illegitimate or even dangerous.

entry.title: Drugs are widely used to sedate dementia patients. Her sons wanted to keep her off them
entry.summary: Potent sedating medications are often used on agitated people with dementia in long-term care facilities despite federal efforts to discourage them. A clash over whether to drug a Michigan woman illuminates the wrenching decisions families and guardians face.

entry.title: The 2026 Student Podcast Challenge Honorable Mentions
entry.summary: Here are the honorable mentions from this year's Student Podcast Challenge, chosen from nearly 1,500 entries.

entry.title: One year after the end of the EV tax credit, is the future still electric?
entry.summary: Congress got rid of a $7,500 federal tax credit for new electric vehicle buyers. One year later, are people still buying EVs?

entry.title: They were promised protection. Instead, these kids with disabilities died in foster care
entry.summary: Disabled kids make up the largest group in foster care. They have the worst outcomes. They stay in foster care longest. They're the most likely to die.
